content:
pagerduty-bot: URGENT: Multiple monitors report region eu-west6 heartbeats missing and control-plane timeouts. >200 nodes unresponsive. P1 triggered.

anna_sre: Confirming on dashboards — control-plane API returning 504/timeout, spikes in node NotReady. Diving in.

jamal_infra: I'm seeing BGP flap events from our transit provider between 03:12-03:16 UTC, lots of conn resets from kube-proxy. Could be upstream network + kernel driver interaction.

maria_eng: Visible to customers: hosted API 502/503 spike for ~2m. Dedicated customers reporting degraded throughput. Paging CS.

lee_netops: Running mtr -> heavy packet loss to region fabric. Contacting provider NOC now.

oliver_cto: Do we have evidence of GPU failures/evictions or is it purely networking? Need to know failover scope.

anna_sre: Node statuses show Kubelet crashloops on a subset. Journal logs show kernel errors in nv_peer_mem when attaching devices — possible driver/kernel panic after network instability.

jamal_infra: Logs snippet: ```journalctl -u kubelet | tail -n 50
May 05 03:14:22 host-23 kubelet: E kubelet: nv-peer-mem: unbind error
May 05 03:14:23 host-24 kubelet: E kubelet: NodeEviction: evicting pods due to NodeNotReady
``` Looks like driver oops followed by node eviction.

maria_eng: Recommend shifting traffic to eu-north1 and us-east1 (eu-north1 preferred for EU latency). Can we do a regional failover now?

anna_sre: Proposed plan: 1) Initiate smart routing failover away from eu-west6 (gradual) 2) Spin up hot spare GPU capacity in eu-north1 3) Pause autoscaler alerts to avoid scale storms.

lee_netops: Provider NOC: "we're seeing switch forwarding plane exhaustion impacting multiple POPs in eu-west6; engineers restarting fabric; ETA unknown."

jamal_infra: Initiating routing shift now: `curl -X POST https://internal-routing/api/fanout -d '{"from":"eu-west6","to":["eu-north1","us-east1"],"mode":"gradual"}'` -> 202 accepted.

deploy-bot: route-rollout triggered -> rollout id r-94832.

anna_sre: Kicking controlled failover. Setting `max_in_flight=10` on routing rollout to avoid downstream overload.

maria_eng: Notifying top impacted customers and support channels with ETA estimate 10-20m for mitigation.

lee_netops: Provider update: they restarted fabric's control plane at 03:45 UTC, partial packet recovery observed. Still seeing intermittent drops.

jamal_infra: Autoscaler had been erroring on zone metrics; manual override `scale_override=1` applied. Spinning 20 hot-spare GPU instances (g4-equivalent) in eu-north1; provisioning started.

anna_sre: Metrics: traffic into eu-west6 down ~50%, new traffic served from eu-north1/us-east1 ~90%. EU tail latency increased ~80ms.

maria_eng: Any customer data/exposure concerns from failover? We didn't change storage or caches, only routing.

oliver_cto: Check KV cache state and consumer consistency. Prioritize Dedicated customers SLA paths. Also flag potential cost impact for finance.

lee_netops: Provider: fabric restart completed but kernel-level oops still present on ~12 GPU hosts in eu-west6. They are escalating to hardware vendor.

anna_sre: Decision: keep eu-west6 isolated from production traffic. Do not reintroduce until vendor driver/kernel patch + soak window. Begin controlled node drains and evacuation.

jamal_infra: Draining nodes now: `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data node-23..node-200` started; pods rescheduled to other regions.

maria_eng: Support status: update sent to #support-notify and CS with workaround and ETA.

deploy-bot: route-rollout r-94832 -> completed (status: success).

lee_netops: Provider confirms hardware vendor engaged; replacement units/reimage scheduled. ETA to fully restore unknown.

anna_sre: Current state: failover successful, majority traffic shifted, eu-west6 control-plane remains unstable. Continuing drains and monitoring.

oliver_cto: Agreed to isolate region. Start incident postmortem and vendor escalation doc. Finance: expect incremental spend for cross-region hotspots; estimate to follow.

sre_rotation_bob: Oncall taking handoff. I'll open an incident ticket, assign sev timeline, and track SLO/errbudget impact.

anna_sre: Closing initial triage — fans out to vendor, infra, netops, eng. Will post follow-ups in incident ticket. :white_check_mark:
